subject: Aligning on demo timing and evaluation kickoff for Carelytic
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Holt <caroline@carelytic.com>, Mark Rivera <mark@carelytic.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & proposed times to book demo + evaluation kickoff

Hi Caroline / Mark —

Thanks again for the thoughtful discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the demo + evaluation kickoff:

Recap (minutes)
- Primary use case: extraction + summarization pipeline for post-visit clinician notes; target throughput from batch ingest and API-driven live calls.
- Initial constraints: PHI in input, on-prem requirement for logs retention, and SLO targets around latency and cost.
- Internal stakeholders you want on the evaluation: ML engineering, product, and security/contact for compliance.

To book the technical deep-dive + trial kickoff, can you confirm which of these slots work for your team?
- Wed Oct 28, 14:00–15:00 PT (17:00–18:00 ET)
- Thu Oct 29, 11:00–12:00 PT (14:00–15:00 ET)

If neither works, send 2–3 windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Tentative agenda I suggest:
- 30m technical deep-dive (integration, sample payloads, KV/cache patterns)
- 20m trial plan & success criteria (metrics, data handling)
- 10m logistics & next steps (accounts, access, timeline)

I’ve attached a one-page trial plan and a sample prompt set to help you prep. Also cc’ing Ben (solutions) and Neha (CS) so they’re looped.

Next steps ask: please confirm attendees (names + roles) and preferred slot.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Carelytic_TrialPlan_v1.pdf (1 page), sample-prompt-set.csv (sample prompts)

From: Caroline Holt <caroline@carelytic.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivera <mark@carelytic.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T12:27:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed times to book demo + evaluation kickoff

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the summary. Wed Oct 28 14:00–15:00 PT works for our ML and product leads; Mark (cc) will bring the security contacts. Attendees so far:
- Caroline Holt, Head of ML
- Mark Rivera, Head of Security (will invite a security engineer)
- Priya Desai, Staff ML Engineer (product integration)

A couple of notes from our side we’d like covered on the deep-dive:
- Success criteria we care about: 95th percentile latency < 150ms for single-turn generation at 512 tokens, end-to-end throughput for batched ingest, and clear data residency/retention controls.
- Cost target: ballpark unit economics for inference (per 1M tokens) so we can estimate TCO during the trial.
- Compliance: we'll need an integration-ready diagram and a list of logs/audit artifacts Redwood can provide.

Attachments: we don’t have anything new yet; will bring sample payloads before the call.

See you on Wed; please send calendar invite.

— Caroline
Caroline Holt
Head of ML | Carelytic Health
caroline@carelytic.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Mark Rivera <mark@carelytic.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed times to book demo + evaluation kickoff

Hi Caroline — thanks, that slot works for us. A few quick technical asks so we can tailor the deep-dive: 

1) Sample payloads: typical length distribution (median token length, 95th), and whether inputs include structured fields (JSON) + free text.
2) Expected QPS during peak and whether you’ll run a sustained batch ingest versus mostly interactive calls.
3) Any network constraints (e.g., VPC peering, egress rules) for the private deployment evaluation.

Planned internal attendees: myself (Solutions Engineer), Aria Patel (Infra Eng), and Daniel Cho (Runtime Architect). We’ll prepare a short architecture sketch showing how Redwood handles KV caching, continuous batching, and quantization options for cost/latency tradeoffs.

I’ll also add 10 minutes to cover audit logs and evidence we can surface during the trial; Neha, could you prepare the onboarding checklist and account access matrix?

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
